name: rg-head-scroll-reserve
summary: Raw Grid's stuck header row reserves its room as the root's scroll-padding through variant-contract 2.1's scrollReserve, now with blockStart, so Tab scrolls an index heading clear of the row
head: 3be9e0e9ef662f5defab02c87d0772a1846f8690

titles: Raw Grid reserves its stuck header row's room at the window's block start, in the query the row sticks in
a 2.1 manifest may reserve the window's block start or block end for a bar pinned there, in lengths the root resolves, and a 2.0 one may not
a variant that reserves the window's block start or block end gets the host's root scroll-padding after its layer, in its media query, and any other gets the same file as before
only a composition whose manifest reserves the window's block start or block end gets the host's root scroll-padding, after its layer
Flux reserves its phone dock's room at the window's block end, in the query the dock docks in
every variant's compiled stylesheet, the kit's layout included, is inside its manifest's css budget
